run_cocofy_lvis_cli: run the script to COCOfy LVIS v0.5 train and val JSON annotation files
run_cocofy_lvis_custom: run cocofy_lvis on a custom LVIS JSON file to filter and remap categories to COCO IDs
create_cocofied_lvis: create a COCOfied LVIS JSON by filtering annotations to only COCO-compatible categories via synset mapping
review_cocofy_lvis: review the cocofy_lvis function that filters LVIS annotations and remaps category IDs to COCO IDs
summarize_COCO_SYNSET_CATEGORIES: summarize the COCO_SYNSET_CATEGORIES constant mapping 90 WordNet synsets to their corresponding COCO category IDs
